# SV templates

Identical on all six wikis. Always write the English name; the localized aliases (redirects) exist so human editors can type a native name.

## SV Bible quote

Quotes a Bible passage through BibleGet, in the wiki's default version. Use it for every verse an article names or alludes to.

Aliases: it: `SV citazione bibbia`, es: `SV cita bíblica`, fr: `SV citation biblique`, de: `SV Bibelzitat`, pt: `SV citação bíblica`

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `ref` | (required) the reference, book names in the wiki's language (Jn 3:16, Gv 3,16, Jean 3,16) |
| `version` | a BibleGet version code; defaults to the wiki's version |
| `inline` | 0 = show the passage as a block instead of a hover quote |

Default version per wiki:

| wiki | version |
|---|---|
| en | NABRE |
| it | CEI2008 |
| es | BLPD |
| fr | NVBSE |
| de | NVBSE |
| pt | NVBSE |

## SV WIP

Marks an article as a work in progress (adds a maintenance category).

Aliases: it: `SV lavori in corso`, es: `SV en desarrollo`, fr: `SV en travaux`, de: `SV in Arbeit`, pt: `SV em construção`

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `user` | who is working on it |
| `date` | since when |

## SV bio

The opening sentence of a biography, written from the page's Wikibase item in the wiki's language: name, birth and death places and dates, occupation and nationality agreeing with the person's sex or gender. Adds no categories; missing facts are left out.

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `item` | a Wikibase item ID, when the page is not connected to one |
| `name` | the name to show instead of the item's label (e.g. a fuller form) |
| `note` | free text after the name, e.g. "pseudonimo di Filippo Neviani" |
| `rest` | free text continuing the sentence after the occupation (starts with a comma or a word) |
| `ref` | references, appended verbatim at the end |

## SV categories

Files the page under its Wikibase item's SV field and SV Gospel theme categories, in the wiki's language. Use it on pages without an SV infobox; every SV infobox outputs the same categories.

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `item` | a Wikibase item ID, when the page is not connected to one |
| `sortkey` | sort key for the categories (e.g. the title without its article) |

## SV category tree

The main page's category navigation (fields, then Gospel themes) from config/categories.json. No parameters.

Aliases: it: `SV albero categorie`, es: `SV árbol de categorías`, fr: `SV arbre des catégories`, de: `SV Kategorienbaum`, pt: `SV árvore de categorias`

## SV cathopedia

A link to an Italian Cathopedia page; on non-Italian wikis adds '(in Italian)'. Use under See also / External links outside it.wiki.

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `1` | (required) the Cathopedia page title, in Italian |
| `2` | link text in the wiki's language; defaults to the title |

## SV cite

A citation (web page, book, journal, video, album liner notes, interview) with fixed parameter names and localized labels.

Aliases: it: `SV cita`, es: `SV cita`, fr: `SV lien`, de: `SV Literatur`, pt: `SV citar`

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `type` | web (default), book, journal, video, liner, interview |
| `title` | (required) |
| `url` |  |
| `author` |  |
| `date` |  |
| `work` | site, newspaper or journal |
| `publisher` |  |
| `isbn` |  |
| `pages` |  |
| `language` |  |
| `archive-url` |  |
| `archive-date` |  |
| `access-date` |  |
| `quote` |  |

## SV discernment

Starts the closing section on how the work relates to the Gospel, with the same heading on every wiki. On its own line.

Aliases: it: `SV discernimento`, es: `SV discernimiento`, fr: `SV discernement`, de: `SV Unterscheidung`, pt: `SV discernimento`

## SV infobox

The SeminaVerbi infobox: layout from the item's instance of, rows from its statements, categories from its SV field / SV Gospel theme. Write just {{SV infobox}}; any row key overrides the item's value.

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `type` | layout when the item's type is missing or ambiguous: book, film, tv, album, song, play, artwork, person, group, work |
| `item` | a Wikibase item ID, when the page is not connected to one |
| `name` | caption; defaults to the item's label |
| `sortkey` | sort key for the item's categories |

## SV infobox person

Infobox for a person, filled from the page's Wikibase item. Any field (see below) overrides the item's value.

Aliases: it: `SV infobox persona`, es: `SV ficha persona`, fr: `SV infobox personne`, de: `SV Infobox Person`, pt: `SV infobox pessoa`

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `item` | a Wikibase item ID, when the page is not connected to one |
| `name` | caption; defaults to the item's label |
| `sortkey` | sort key for the item's categories |

Fields: image, birth_date, birth_place, death_date, death_place, occupation

## SV infobox work

Infobox for a work, filled from the page's Wikibase item. Any field of its type (see below) overrides the item's value.

Aliases: it: `SV infobox opera`, es: `SV ficha obra`, fr: `SV infobox œuvre`, de: `SV Infobox Werk`, pt: `SV infobox obra`

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `type` | book (default), film, tv, album, song, play, artwork |
| `item` | a Wikibase item ID, when the page is not connected to one |
| `name` | caption; defaults to the item's label |
| `sortkey` | sort key for the item's categories |

Fields per `type`:

- `book`: image, title, author, original_language_work, publication_date, genre, country_of_origin, follows, followed_by
- `film`: image, title, director, screenwriter, cast, publication_date, original_language_film, country_of_origin, genre
- `tv`: image, title, creator, cast, original_language_film, country_of_origin, genre, publication_date
- `album`: image, title, performer, publication_date, genre, record_label
- `song`: image, title, performer, composer, lyrics_by, publication_date, genre
- `play`: image, title, author, original_language_work, publication_date, genre
- `artwork`: image, title, creator, inception
- `work`: image, title, creator, publication_date, genre, country_of_origin
- `group`: image, inception, genre, record_label, country_of_origin

## SV quote

A quotation that is not from the Bible, optionally with its original-language text above the translation.

Aliases: it: `SV citazione`, es: `SV cita textual`, fr: `SV citation`, de: `SV Zitat`, pt: `SV citação`

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `text` | (required) the quotation in the wiki's language; wikitext allowed |
| `author` | may be a link |
| `source` | the work or document; may be a link |
| `original` | the quotation in its original language |
| `original_lang` | language code of original (it, la, grc…) |

## SV references

The references heading and list. On its own line, near the end of the article.

Aliases: it: `SV note`, es: `SV referencias`, fr: `SV références`, de: `SV Einzelnachweise`, pt: `SV referências`

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `group` | a reference group name |
